rows.about_company: Kamra Energy Solution is a Mohali-based industrial manufacturer with integrated production units in Punjab and Gujarat. We serve infrastructure and building-materials customers across India and export to the Middle East. Energy efficiency and waste heat recovery are core to our operating model: every unit runs under an ISO 50001-aligned energy management system and reports specific energy consumption quarterly under the BEE PAT scheme.
rows.leadership_message: FY 2025-26 marked a turning point in our sustainability journey. We completed our first full GHG inventory covering Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions across all manufacturing units, commissioned a 2 MW rooftop solar plant, and achieved a 12% reduction in specific energy consumption against our PAT baseline. Our net-zero pathway, approved by the Board this year, commits us to a 42% absolute reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2030 and net zero by 2050. None of this is possible without our people, our communities and our partners. This report sets out, with full transparency, where we stand and where we are going.
